annotations.title: Find cases by customer name, email, phone, date of birth, support code, order or tracking number, vendor or Stripe ID, or message words, with status and date filters

description: Find cases by customer name, email, phone, date of birth, support code, order or tracking number, vendor or Stripe ID, or message words, with status and date filters. Returns one current workspace per verified customer (explicit splits stay separate), with the actual ticket code, all issue references, plan and run progress, orders and message excerpts. Message case_id opens the workspace; source_case_id retains the original issue. Search matches are leads, not proof of identity or completed work.

activity_after.description: Cases updated at or after this time

created_after.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

created_before.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

dob.description: Exact date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. With q, keeps only customers that match both.

messages.description: Also search message text for q. Needs q.

q.description: Customer name, email, phone, support code, order or tracking number, Stripe, MDI, Beluga or GEN ID, or care session ID. With messages=true, also words in customer and team messages.
